### Added
- `kagent.oauth2ProxyIngress.additionalPeers` (default `[]`), in both charts: extra callers the kagent oauth2-proxy ingress policy admits on the proxy port (4180) next to the public Gateway's Envoy pods — a list of pod label maps (`matchLabels`), each rendered as one more `fromEndpoints` entry (cilium flavor; the kubernetes flavor renders no oauth2-proxy policy). A peer in another namespace carries its own `io.kubernetes.pod.namespace`; an item that is not a non-empty label map fails the render. For an installation whose kagent hostname sits on a private edge LB and whose kagent API is reached from elsewhere through a Teleport tunnel: the local `teleport-kube-agent` (`app: teleport-kube-agent` in `kube-system`) proxies the tunnel's requests to oauth2-proxy and was dropped by the policy, so the tunnel hung without an HTTP answer. `make verify-kagent-netpol` covers it. **No installation needs to act**: the default render is unchanged.
